topics.headline: Eurozone flash confirms drop; US June CPI also expected lower
topics.summary: Eurozone June flash HICP fell to 2.8% from 3.2%, already breaking the "both higher" scenario, while forecasters (BMO, FutureSearch) expect US June CPI to post a negative monthly print on collapsing gasoline prices post-Hormuz de-escalation—making a joint acceleration in both CPI and HICP highly unlikely.

topics.headline: HY spreads near multi-decade tights, but supply and Fed risks tilt wider
topics.summary: HY OAS sits around 267-282bps, just off historic lows, with weekly data already showing modest widening amid heavy issuance; most sell-side desks (LPL, PineBridge, Allianz GI) see limited room to tighten further and lean toward gradual widening risk from record 2026 supply, though fundamentals and fund flows remain supportive for now.

topics.headline: BTC ETF flows flip positive after 8-week outflow streak, but conviction is thin
topics.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $197M in weekly inflows and a positive 7-day tally ($124.9M), snapping an eight-week, ~$8B redemption streak, but 30-day flows remain -$4.73B and volume is 20% below average, so analysts call it a cautious re-entry, not a confirmed reversal. July 14-15 CPI/PPI data and the July 28-29 FOMC meeting are the key near-term catalysts that could decide whether inflows persist through the next week.

topics.headline: VIX compression meets Iran escalation risk as sanctions deadline nears
topics.summary: VIX sits near 15 with implied vol below realized vol—an unusual compression—even as Treasury cuts off Iran oil sales July 17 and traders eye a break above 22 as confirmation of a real volatility spike; the setup looks fragile but the level itself remains historically unremarkable.

topics.headline: Hyperscaler power deals show no signs of slowing
topics.summary: Given the near-continuous cadence of nuclear, gas, and renewable PPAs (OpenAI-Oracle's 4.5GW Stargate expansion, Chevron's 4GW behind-the-meter buildout, Valar/Nvidia's nuclear-powered data center), a new dedicated power deal within 30 days is highly likely; the real story is regulators and ratepayers pushing back via FERC show-cause orders and Virginia's new data-center taxes/rate classes.
